title: Revised Prices of Anti-Cancer Medicines to Come into Effect from 9th November;
subtitle:
More than 1000 medicines of different brands show marked Price reduction;
Estimated annual savings to consumers expected to be above ₹3500 crore
body_text: National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, capped trade margins on MRP of 137 anti-cancer drugs, based on the recommendations of Expert Committee constituted by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) under Ministry of Health & Family Welfare on 17 th October, 2026.  The revised prices of these drugs will come into effect from 9 th November, 2026. As on date, 76 pharmaceutical companies have reported revised MRP for 1225 anti-cancer formulations, covering 121 drugs. Reduction in the MRP have been reported in 1031 formulations of anti-cancer medicines, with 600 brands reporting above 50% reduction and the highest reduction being 96.45%. Further, out of the 137 identified anti-cancer drugs, there are 10-15 drugs which are yet to be launched in India. However, Trade Margin Rationalization (TMR) will be applicable on these drugs also as and when they are launched. As a result of the price reductions to be effected from 9 th November, 2026, the estimated annual savings to consumers would be ₹3,502.31 crore. efforts to improve affordability and accessibility of essential anti-cancer medicines for cancer care. The notification SO 5690 (E ) dated 17 th October, 2026 will remain in force until further orders However, manufacturers can avail annual price increase in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 20(1) of the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013, subject to continued compliance with the maximum permissible trade margin of 30% Every retailer, dealer, hospital and institution is required to prominently display Revised MRP list of anti-cancer medicines on their websites and in their premises. As per the NPPA notification, State Drug Controllers will monitor compliance by manufacturers, dealers, Hospitals and Medical Institutions. Consumers can check the applicable prices through the Pharma Sahi Daam mobile application and the NPPA website ( www.nppa.gov.in ) and report any non-compliance or violation of revised prices to the authority. Complaints can be submitted through the following channels: Email: monitoring-nppa[at]gov[dot]in Helpline: 1800-11-1255 Post: Deputy Director, Monitoring, NPPA, 3rd Floor, YMCA Cultural Centre Building, 1 Jai Singh Marg, New Delhi – 110001. ***** PC/PM
